title.narrative: PLATFORM FOR AGRICULTURAL RISK MANAGEMENT (PARM)

description.narrative: The long term development goal of PARM is to contribute to sustainable agricultural systems, boost rural investment, reduce food insecurity, gender equality, and improve resilience to climate, production and market shocks of rural households. The specific objective for the 2019-24 period is the integration of ARM in the agricultural policies, institutional capacities and investments of key stakeholders to promote a holistic management of risks from global to local levels.
